label: b42: Revisiting Discrete SAC (row B2), 16 lanes, hist8 at 50M moves (3.125M counted steps), paper cell as written (lr 1e-5, alpha 0.05, 2x512) beside b41's local cell plus the two fixes (entropy-penalty 0.5, avg-Q + Q-clip 0.5), paper cell, seed 1 of 8
notes: Batch b42: row B2 of the algorithm series, Revisiting Discrete SAC (Zhou, Wang, Feng & Zhou 2022, arXiv 2209.10081) -- the two fixes that made discrete SAC competitive on Atari, an entropy-penalty on the per-state change in policy entropy (beta 0.5, the collecting policy's entropy stored with each transition) and double average Q with a Q-clip (c 0.5), with the temperature fixed at 0.05. Two cells x 4 seeds, 16 lanes, 50M moves = 3,125,000 counted steps, the same budget as b41. sac2paper (b42a-d): the paper's Table 3 as closely as this stack allows -- Adam 1e-5 actor and critics, batch 64, 1e5 uniform replay, 0.1 gradient updates a move, Polyak 0.005 every update, 3-step, alpha fixed 0.05, MSE with the Q-clip, network 2 x 512 (the paper's MLP after its CNN; snek3's reference trunk is fc 320). Not the paper's: the reward is snek3's unclipped preset (the paper clips to [-1, 1]; food 1, death -5, perfect +100), the observation is the 26-value vector with 8 frames of history, and the budget is 50M moves against the paper's 10M Atari steps. Expected weak by the series' rule (algorithm-series.md section 0): at lr 1e-5 the gate arm's Q-clip never bound (0.0 of samples) and the paper's own runs needed 10M steps to separate from baseline. sac2local (b42e-h): b41e-h's local cell (target entropy 0.1 ln|A| tuned by gradient, batch 128, PER 0.6, 100k replay, 0.5 updates a move, hard target every 8, lr 3e-4, 1-step, fc 320) plus the paper's two fixes and nothing else -- entropy-penalty 0.5, avg-Q with Q-clip 0.5 -- so the pair reads directly against b41e-h: same seeds 5-8, same everything but the fixes. One forced change rides with the clip: the clipped critic loss is on the squared error as the paper writes it, so the local cell trains its critics on squared error where b41e-h used Huber (SNEK_SAC_CRITIC_LOSS=huber is set and is inert while the clip is on). Why now (2026-09-20): b41e-h reached best30 89-93 by 59k-78k counted steps, the fastest onset in the project, then drifted to 67-72% perfect by 1.03M with a strong-eval fraction of 15-20%; the hold is the problem, and the paper's two fixes are hold mechanisms. The plan's earlier B2 design (4 paper seeds + 4 seeds with alpha auto at the paper's target) was dropped because b41 showed the 0.98 target degenerate on three actions; alpha auto at 0.1 is the local cell's setting instead. Gates (2026-09-20): sac2 smoke checkpoints and restores; tests/mut_sac.json 16 of 16 killed after the per-state entropy-penalty rewrite and the post-critic-step actor evaluation (both from an external review the same day); gate-2 500k-move laptop arms of both cells log a non-zero per-state penalty (paper cell: 0.0004-0.018 on all 31 evals, the Q-clip binding on at most 0.8% of critic samples and 0 at the end, entropy 0.88 -> 0.17 under the fixed 0.05, score 63 and no perfect game at 31k counted steps; local cell: 0.01-0.066 on every eval, clip 0.0 through 11k steps, alpha 1.0 -> 0.001 with the entropy held at 0.116 by the penalty, 14% perfect by 11k steps). Prediction (agent, 2026-09-20): the paper cell reads a non-zero perfect rate -- the temperature is fixed, so b41's alpha runaway cannot recur -- but at lr 1e-5 its onset is late, after 1.5M counted steps if at all within the budget, its plateau below b41e-h's, and its Q-clip fraction stays near 0. The local cell has b41e-h's onset (best30 above 85 by 0.1M) and the test is the hold: its entropy stays within 0.02 nats of the 0.11 target where b41e-h's wandered, its perfect rate after 1M stays above 80 against b41e-h's 67-72, its strong-eval fraction beats b41e-h's at the same horizon, and the Q-clip binds on 1-5% of critic samples at 3e-4. It still does not reach PPO's 95% stage-B density. Unpinned; either box claims waves of 4.
